title: Survivor Coverage, Activation and Age Limits in the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans Terms
content:
Three life events end or continue coverage under the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** in their own way.

**Death of the purchaser of a member-and-family plan.** The surviving family members keep coverage under the tier's survivor continuation rule and are billed at the member-and-family rate until it ends.

**Call to active duty.** When a TRICARE Reserve Select member is called to active duty for more than 30 days, the plan ends under the tier's activation effect on the day before the orders start, unpaid future bills are cancelled by a credit, and the member may buy the plan again within the qualifying-life-event window after deactivation.

**Retired Reserve age limit.** A TRICARE Retired Reserve plan ends under the tier's coverage-end rule when the member reaches the tier's age limit, and the member and family then enroll in TRICARE Prime or TRICARE Select as retirees within the qualifying-life-event window.

## Outcomes at a glance

| Event | Plan | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| purchaser dies | member-and-family tier | family members continue under the survivor continuation rule, billed at the member-and-family rate |
| orders for more than 30 days | TRICARE Reserve Select | plan ends the day before the orders start; unpaid future bills cancelled by a credit; may be bought again within the qualifying-life-event window after deactivation |
| member reaches the age limit | TRICARE Retired Reserve | plan ends under the coverage-end rule; member and family enroll in TRICARE Prime or TRICARE Select as retirees within the qualifying-life-event window |

*Hypothetical:* a TRICARE Reserve Select member whose orders for 180 days start on 15 March has a plan that ends on 14 March.
